name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before countertop installers arrive, clear all items off the existing counters and empty the base cabinets beneath the sink and cooktop. Clear a wide, unobstructed pathway from the home entry to the kitchen so heavy slabs can be carried in safely. You should also have your new sink, faucet, and cooktop on site so dimensions and cutouts match precisely during templating and setting. Plan alternative meal preparations while your sink and plumbing remain temporarily disconnected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all counters, empty sink base cabinets, secure walking pathways, and have your new sink, faucet, and cooktop on site for exact cutout fitting.
